description: This file defines the Date class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared namespace, providing static methods and constants for handling date and time conversions, formats, and calendar settings within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: A class providing static utility methods for date/time conversions, format validation, and calendar configurations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: setExcelCalendar
methods.description: Sets the internal calendar base year for date calculations, supporting either Windows 1900 or Mac 1904 calendars.

methods.name: getExcelCalendar
methods.description: Returns the current calendar base year used for date calculations.

methods.name: setDefaultTimezone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone for date/time conversions within the library.

methods.name: getDefaultTimezone
methods.description: Retrieves the default DateTimeZone object, returning UTC if none is set.

methods.name: getDefaultOrLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the default timezone or the system's local timezone if not set.

methods.name: getDefaultTimezoneOrNull
methods.description: Returns the default timezone, which may be null if not explicitly set.

methods.name: validateTimeZone
methods.description: Validates and returns a DateTimeZone object from a string or object, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: convertIsoDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO-8601 string into an Excel serial date number.

methods.name: excelToDateTimeObject
methods.description: Converts an Excel serial date number to a PHP DateTime object considering calendar and timezone.

methods.name: excelToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts an Excel serial date number to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: PHPToExcel
methods.description: Converts various PHP date representations (DateTime, timestamp, string) into an Excel serial date number.

methods.name: dateTimeToExcel
methods.description: Converts a PHP DateTime object into an Excel serial date number.

methods.name: timestampToExcel
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to an Excel serial date number.

methods.name: formattedPHPToExcel
methods.description: Calculates an Excel serial date number from year, month, day, hours, minutes, and seconds.

methods.name: isDateTime
methods.description: Determines if a cell value is a date/time based on its style and content.

methods.name: isDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given NumberFormat code represents a date/time format.

methods.name: isDateTimeFormatCode
methods.description: Checks if a specific format code string can be considered a date/time format.

methods.name: stringToExcel
methods.description: Converts a date string into an Excel serial number, if possible.

methods.name: monthStringToNumber
methods.description: Converts a month name or abbreviation to its numeric representation (1-12).

methods.name: dayStringToNumber
methods.description: Removes ordinal suffixes from a day string and converts it to an integer.

methods.name: dateTimeFromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a PHP DateTime object from a Unix timestamp and optional timezone.

methods.name: formattedDateTimeFromTimestamp
methods.description: Outputs a formatted date/time string from a Unix timestamp and format.
